responsibility: This header declares the system-facing storage allocation interface used by the mc-boot runtime. It exports the low-level heap procedures for allocation, deallocation, reallocation, availability testing, and heap initialization that form the backend contract implemented by SysStorage and wrapped by the higher-level Storage module.
same_name_distinction: This .h file is the interface side of the GSysStorage pair, declaring the low-level SysStorage_* allocation backend used by higher layers, while gcc/m2/mc-boot/GSysStorage.cc contains the libc-based implementation and debug/zeroing behavior.
